definitions.explanation: A person who gathers, organizes, and edits material into a systematic reference work such as a dictionary, encyclopedia, anthology, or historical chronicle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}させた→完成させる：02519_kanseisaseru⟧。
examples.english: The dictionary's compiler spent many years completing this work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{百科事典|ひゃっかじてん}→百科事典：05144_hyakkajiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新版|しんぱん}→新版：22067_shinpan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The encyclopedia's editorial team is preparing a new edition.

examples.japanese: {編纂者|へんさんしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{名高|なだか}い→名高い：11956_nadakai⟧{金田一|きんだいち}{京助|きょうすけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{貢献|こうけん}した→貢献する：21682_koukensuru⟧。
examples.english: Kindaichi Kyosuke, renowned as a compiler, made great contributions to the development of Japanese dictionaries.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{編纂|へんさん}→編纂：13889_hensan⟧ (compilation, editing) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Specifically refers to someone who compiles large-scale reference works, as opposed to a general editor who edits individual works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}: dictionary compiler
- ⟦{百科事典|ひゃっかじてん}→百科事典：05144_hyakkajiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}: encyclopedia editor
- {歴史書|れきししょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}: compiler of historical records
- {主|しゅ}{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}: chief editor/compiler

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{編集者|へんしゅうしゃ}→編集者：09587_henshuusha⟧: editor — a more general term for someone who edits books, magazines, or other publications
- ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧: author — someone who writes original content, rather than compiling existing material
- {監修者|かんしゅうしゃ}: supervisor, general editor — someone who oversees a project without doing the hands-on compilation
